OFFICIAL GAZETTE
of the sitio of Walingon; thence N. 89° 00° W., 24 kms. in a straight
•line to a point about two kilometers southeast of the sitio of Apo
Cayo; thence approximately N. 27° 30' W. in a straight line to a
point where it intersects another straight line drawn from the shoe
at the barrio of Portulin, municipality of Medina, which is identical
to the present Talisavan-Medina boundary and an inland prolongatin
of this boundary to a distance of 19 kilometers from the shore at
Portulin; thence N. 82° 20 W., 7 kilometers, to the point of inter-
section of the present boundaries of Kinoguitan, Claveria, and Salay;
and on the east, by the present Misamis Oriental-Agusar Soundary;
and such parts of the abuve described portion of the erritory of
Claveria as are contiguous to the municipalities of Lingos. Gingoog,
Medina and Talisayan are hereby respectively annexed to these
municipalities. The present boundaries between Linuges and Gin-
g00g, between Gingoog and Medina, and between Medina and Tali-
sayan shall be extended as follows:
(a) Linugos-Gingoog boundary:-From the point where the Bina-
wangan River intersects the present Claveria boundary, following this
river upstream to its source in the mountain towards the southeast;
thence from this source to the highest point of the said mountain on
the present boundary between Misamis Oriental and Asusan.
(b) Gingoog-Medina boundary: -From the point where the present
Gingoog-Medina boundary intersects the present boundary of the
muricipal district of Claveria southwestward in a straight line
running as a continuation of, and following the same direction as,
the said present Gingoog-Medina boundary until it intersects he
southwest boundary of the portion of the territory of Claveria
described above.
(c) Medina-Talisavan boundary:-From the point where the
present Medina-Talisayan boundary intersects the present boundary
of the municipal district of Claveria, southwestward in a straight
line that runs as a continuation of and follows the same direction
as the said present Medina-Talisayan boundary to a poins 19 kalo-
meters from the shore.
(These boundary descriptions are based upon data shown in the
map of Talisayan, Medina, Gingoog, and Linugos, submitted April
26, 1949, by the District. Engineer, and drawn to scale 1:50,000.)
The annexation herein made shall take effect immediately.
Dore in the City of Manila, this 15th day of June, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-nine,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the third.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
